purpose: Authoritative-source-backed game-content provenance registry foundation. This layer separates release/update evidence from research timestamps and does not rewrite canonical skill records unless an individual skill is directly tied to the cited release evidence.
rules: A research date is not a game-version date.
A DLC/update announcement establishes content availability/provenance, not balance changes unless the source explicitly documents a change.
A skill is not assigned to a release event merely because its DLC label resembles the event; direct content linkage is required.

research_gaps.claim: Official Bandai Namco release notice confirms a free update shipped alongside the DAIMA Pack and included Skills, but the canonical skills database currently contains no skill record explicitly labeled with that free update or otherwise explicitly tied to the May 2025 free-update skill subset.
research_gaps.action: Do not assign unidentified canonical skills to the free update by name, date, or proximity. Resolve only with direct skill-level evidence from authoritative/independent catalog sources.

research_gaps.claim: Official Bandai Namco source confirms the May 21 2025 free update included Skills, but does not name those Skills in the announcement. The canonical skill dataset has six explicitly DAIMA Pack skills and no separately labeled May 2025 free-update skill records.
research_gaps.resolution: Preserve the free-update event as provenance context only; do not assign individual skill IDs until direct evidence names them.

research_gaps.claim: Official Free Update 20 announcement establishes four Festival skills, while the current canonical skills store exposes only one record explicitly labeled Festival of Universes (Galaxy Breaker (Festival)).
research_gaps.resolution: Treat the four-skill event scope as authoritative provenance, but do not manufacture three missing canonical skill IDs. Research the fourth Festival event reward schedule and canonical catalog to identify all four named skills.

research_gaps.claim: Official Free Update 20 documentation establishes exactly four Budokai Festival skills, but the accessible text does not provide their names. The canonical skills dataset currently contains only one record explicitly labeled Festival of Universes (Galaxy Breaker (Festival)), so adding four named mappings would risk fabricating identities.
research_gaps.action: Add/recover complete canonical records for the four named Festival skills, including IDs and full mechanics/acquisition fields, only after reconciling the catalog against existing research batches.
